europe_now.title: Europe: Raging wildfires scorch large swaths of the continent
europe_now.summary: Wildfires in Croatia have injured dozens and prompted mass evacuations, while France continues to battle blazes in the Landes region. These incidents highlight the continent's increasing vulnerability to extreme weather conditions.

top_stories.title: Hungary uses sunken barges to raise Danube River to keep nuclear plant going
top_stories.summary: Hungary has deployed sunken barges to elevate the Danube River level, ensuring the continued operation of the Paks nuclear power plant. This measure addresses critical cooling requirements amid ongoing drought conditions in the region.
